summary: Retest of the single iteration_17 failure (Home footer missing) + new UX (address auto-return in pick mode). Both PRIMARY items pass. Home footer renders at bottom with logo, tagline, 4 link pills (footer-support/orders/subs/addresses), delivery hours, 'Serving 75+ pincodes', support@freshcuts.in and copyright. Footer-support -> /support, footer-subs -> /subscriptions confirmed. Pick-mode auto-return: after OTP login with fresh mobile 9937268145 + item added + pincode 400001 + Proceed to Checkout -> ck-add-addr -> /addresses?pick=1 -> filled form -> addr-save -> auto-redirected to /checkout?address_id=... with ck-selected-addr visible showing 'Auto Test · 9998887771 / Flat 101, Test Bldg, Fort – 400001' and Place order enabled — WITHOUT needing an extra tap. Quick smoke: no red screen, Daily Picks 8 cards (3 deals + 5 picks), floating cart FAB compact 134.7px wide right-aligned pill (x=250, h=47).

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (theme.shadow.* used throughout). Non-blocking, but appears on every screen.
Warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:194 (LinearGradient uses pointerEvents="none" as prop).

React warns 'React does not recognize the defaultMuted prop on a DOM element' — camelCase attribute passed to native <video>. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:50 (`defaultMuted: true` in React.createElement). Should be spelled `defaultmuted` or removed (muted alone is sufficient).

test_verification.1_home_footer: PASS — All 4 testIDs (footer-support, footer-orders, footer-subs, footer-addresses) present & visible. All required text found: logo image, tagline 'Farm-fresh whole & pre-cut...', 'Delivery 7 AM – 9 PM', 'Serving 75+ pincodes across Mumbai', 'support@freshcuts.in', '© 2026 FreshCuts'. footer-support navigates to /support; footer-subs navigates to /subscriptions.
test_verification.2_address_auto_return: PASS — OTP login with fresh 10-digit mobile (9937268145 + 123456) -> home add first pick to cart -> /cart pincode 400001 + Check -> proceed-checkout-btn -> /checkout. ck-add-addr tap -> /addresses?pick=1 with empty-state auto-showing the form. Filled name/mobile/line1/area/pincode -> addr-save -> URL becomes /checkout?address_id=<uuid> automatically. ck-selected-addr visible with Auto Test details; place-order-btn disabled=False. No extra tap on address card needed.
test_verification.3_smoke: PASS — Home renders without red screen. Daily Picks = 3 deal-card + 5 pick-card = 8 total. Floating cart FAB after adding 1 item: x=249.9, y=696.3, width=134.7px, height=47.4px — compact right-aligned pill.

action_items: Optional: Silence RN Web deprecation warnings by migrating theme.shadow.* to boxShadow and moving LinearGradient pointerEvents='none' from prop into style.
Optional: Fix HeroVideo defaultMuted DOM prop warning in index.tsx:50 — either drop the defaultMuted key (muted already set) or spell it lowercase defaultmuted.
critical_code_review_comments: addresses.tsx save() correctly does router.replace to /checkout with address_id when isPick — good, avoids back-stack pollution.
checkout.tsx preselects address via params.address_id in useFocusEffect load(), so returning from /addresses immediately shows ck-selected-addr — verified.
Home footer JSX (lines 322-357) matches the styles defined below; regression fixed.
seed_data_creation: Created OTP users 9937268145 and 9667351538 during testing; added one address 'Auto Test / Flat 101, Test Bldg, Fort / 400001' plus one incomplete address record on backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_17 regression (missing home footer JSX) and the pick-mode auto-return UX are both verified working. No further action needed for this bundle. Only minor RN Web deprecation warnings remain (shadow*/pointerEvents/defaultMuted) — see action_items.
